idea-plugin.name: Visual App Editor
idea-plugin.description:
Visual editing of app UI source code (Flutter .dart, React / React Native .tsx/.jsx) through the Visual App Editor service: widget tree of the current file, a properties panel, a toolbox and a device size switcher. Every change is a normal, undoable edit of your source file.
Requires the vae_service (configure it under Settings | Tools | Visual App Editor).
